components.name: AllRulesSample

violations.message: Mutates a value with '=' directly during render.
violations.recommendation: Move the mutation into an event handler or effect.
violations.compilerReason: Encountered a mutation of a value that may be shared: mutating a value in a reactive scope invalidates the compiler's ability to create stable memoized outputs.
violations.blockedOptimization: Reactive-scope creation — the compiler cannot create a stable memoized output if the value is mutated during render.

violations.message: Reads 'ref.current' during render. Component render must be pure and deterministic.
violations.recommendation: Move ref access to an effect (useEffect), an event handler, or use state (useState) instead if you need to trigger a re-render.
violations.compilerReason: Reading ref.current during render: refs are mutable containers whose values are invisible to the compiler's dependency tracking. The compiler cannot include ref values in reactive scopes, so a component that reads refs during render will be bailed out to avoid producing stale memoized output.
violations.blockedOptimization: Reactive-scope dependency analysis — ref.current is opaque to the compiler's dataflow graph; it cannot reason about when re-memoization is needed.

violations.message: Calls state updater 'setCount' during render.
violations.recommendation: Call state updaters from an event handler or an effect, not during render.
violations.compilerReason: setState (or a dispatcher returned by useState) is called unconditionally during the render phase. Calling setState during render creates an infinite re-render loop; the compiler will not attempt to memoize a component that exhibits this pattern.
violations.blockedOptimization: Full-component memoization — setState in render is an infinite-loop hazard; the compiler refuses to optimise such components.

violations.message: Mutates a prop or state object during render.
violations.recommendation: Create a new shallow copy before changing the object or array.
violations.compilerReason: Found a mutation of a prop or state value. Props and state must be treated as immutable during render; the compiler relies on referential stability to determine which reactive scopes can be skipped.
violations.blockedOptimization: Auto-memoization of props — mutating props breaks the compiler's referential-equality assumption that drives skip decisions.

components.name: NestedChild

violations.message: Defines component 'NestedChild' inside another component.
violations.recommendation: Move the nested component to module scope.
violations.compilerReason: A React component is defined inside another component's render body. Nested component definitions create a new function identity on every render, which defeats memoization. The compiler bails out of optimising the inner component and may also bail out of the outer one.
violations.blockedOptimization: Inner-component memoization — a new function reference on every render means the compiler's cached output is always stale for the inner component.

violations.message: Calls Math.random() directly during render.
violations.recommendation: Move the call into an event handler or an appropriate effect/memoization boundary.
violations.compilerReason: Detected a call to an impure function (e.g. Math.random, Date.now) during render. Impure calls produce different values on every invocation; the compiler cannot safely memoize a reactive scope whose output depends on a value that changes non-deterministically.
violations.blockedOptimization: Deterministic reactive-scope memoization — the compiler assumes render is a pure function of its inputs; impure calls violate that assumption.

violations.message: Reads or accesses a browser DOM global during render.
violations.recommendation: Move browser global access into useEffect or an event handler.
violations.compilerReason: A DOM or BOM global (e.g. window, document, localStorage) is accessed during render. These globals are environment-specific side effects that the compiler cannot track as reactive values, forcing a bailout.
violations.blockedOptimization: Server-safe reactive-scope generation — DOM globals are unavailable in server rendering contexts; the compiler bails out to preserve consistent behavior across environments.
